title: The second apartment's door
logline: The smaller apartment's door from the hall, invented: a number the page doesn't letter, a mat, a folded newspaper, and beside the door a bag with a strap set down, packed. The page stops at the door and doesn't decide which way the bag is going.

panels.composition: An apartment door from a hallway with an unreadable number, a mat, a folded newspaper, and a canvas bag with a strap set down packed beside the door.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an apartment door seen from a hallway with an unreadable number and a mat and a folded newspaper, a packed canvas bag with a strap set down beside the door, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Which way the bag is going: not decided.
